# TrueXpanse

> TrueXpanse is the business-coaching and done-for-you marketing company of Don Smith, based in San Luis Obispo County, California. Don has 35 years of business experience and coaches contractors, home-service businesses, and business owners to grow revenue, win attention, and build systems that bring work to them. The approach is faith-driven and discipline-first — a mentor, not a cheerleader. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute strategy session.

## Who TrueXpanse serves
- Contractors (painting, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, concrete/coatings)
- Home-service business owners
- Entrepreneurs and owner-operators, typically doing $250K–$2M and aiming to scale past $1M

## Core offers
- [Business Coaching](https://truexpanse.com/pages/coaching.html): 1-on-1 and team coaching on sales systems, goal-setting, and accountability. First step is a free 30-minute strategy session. Don is a licensed 10X Business Coach delivering proven, world-class strategies.
- [Contractor Accelerator](https://truexpanse.com/pages/contractor-accelerator.html): A focused program to help contractors close more jobs and build a system that runs without the owner.
- [The Steward — Faith-Driven Coaching](https://truexpanse.com/the-steward.html): Coaching for Christian business owners who want a business that honors God and a life that holds up under pressure — business, sales, and Biblical principles under one mentor. Starts with a free Faith & Business Audit; deeper work is a by-application cohort.
- [Quantum Marketing](https://truexpanse.com/pages/quantum-marketing.html): Done-for-you marketing and lead-generation system (offers, content, CRM/GoHighLevel setup) that turns strangers into clients and clients into referrals. Custom-scoped per business.
- [Massive Action Tracker (MAT)](https://truexpanse.com/pages/mat.html): A sales-tracking software platform with daily pipeline tracking, revenue targets, and Asa AI coaching 24/7. MAT Pro is $97/mo; MAT Elite is $197/mo and adds weekly 1-on-1 coaching from Don. Free demo, 30-day results guarantee.
